opencode.notes: skill_path targets .opencode/commands/ rather than .opencode/skills/ as a safety property, not a preference: opencode skills are model-invoked through its native `skill` tool and have no `disable-model-invocation` equivalent, so shipping fourteen worktree-creating, branch-pushing workflows as skills would make them auto-startable. Commands are `/`-invoked only. Subdirectories under .opencode take their plural names.
opencode.steering_notes: No documented modular rules/instructions auto-load path; steering installs to receipt-owned `.shipmates/contributor-steering.md` — open it when contributing to Shipmates.

antigravity.notes: Antigravity CLI (agy) replaced the retired Gemini CLI (shut down June 18, 2026). Workspace agents live at `.agents/agents/{name}.md` with YAML frontmatter (`subagent: true`, `mainAgent: false`), skills at `.agents/skills/{name}/SKILL.md`. The CLI reads project instructions from AGENTS.md with GEMINI.md as the legacy fallback.
antigravity.steering_notes: No documented modular rules/instructions auto-load path; steering installs to receipt-owned `.shipmates/contributor-steering.md` — open it when contributing to Shipmates.

codex.notes: Subagents GA March 2026. Project-scoped agents at `.codex/agents/<name>.toml` — standalone TOML, NOT Markdown with frontmatter, and the only target so far that is not. Fields: name, description, developer_instructions. Codex documents no per-agent tool allowlist, so `permission_model` is `none`: least privilege genuinely cannot be expressed on this target and the crew inherit the session's tools. Recorded rather than faked — an invented `tools` key would be ignored at best, rejected at worst. Skills follow the open Agent Skills standard at `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (Codex reads `.agents/skills`, NOT `.codex/skills`); only the crew are Codex-native under `.codex/`. Verified 2026-08-03.
codex.steering_notes: No documented modular rules/instructions auto-load path; steering installs to receipt-owned `.shipmates/contributor-steering.md` — open it when contributing to Shipmates.

cursor.notes: Cursor ships no subagents, so the adapter emits only the fourteen commands as skills and ignores `roles`. Cursor reads the open Agent Skills tree `.agents/skills/` natively (a first-party peer of `.cursor/skills/`, since Cursor 2.4), so skills ship to the shared `.agents/skills/` location — byte-identical with codex/antigravity/copilot. Verified 2026-08-03.

github-copilot.notes: Custom agents at `.github/agents/<name>.agent.md` — the double extension is required; a plain `<name>.md` in that directory is never discovered. Markdown + YAML frontmatter; `tools` takes the canonical names (read, search, edit, execute, web, agent) and OMITTING the key enables every tool, so an empty mapping must never silently become an unrestricted agent. Frontmatter + body capped at 30,000 characters. Copilot accepts skills at `.github/skills`, `.claude/skills` AND the open `.agents/skills` (all first-party, since 2025-12-18), so skills ship to the shared `.agents/skills/` tree — byte-identical with codex/antigravity/cursor; only the crew are `.github`-native. Verified 2026-08-03.

windsurf.notes: Windsurf (Cascade) discovers skills under `.windsurf/skills/`. It ships no subagents, so the adapter emits the crew as fourteen skills and ignores `roles`.
windsurf.steering_notes: No documented modular rules/instructions auto-load path; steering installs to receipt-owned `.shipmates/contributor-steering.md` — open it when contributing to Shipmates.
